(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure, the forward section including a first open rib structure reinforcing a first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing a second corner buttress; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress; and an open rib structure reinforcing each of said corner buttresses; a first aero cover spanning and closing a first open rib structure associated with said first corner buttress; and a second aero cover spanning and closing a second open rib structure associated with said second corner buttress.
